blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. appointed Social Security System chief Robert Joseph Montes de Claro as the new head of the Department of Information and Communications Technology (DICT) on Tuesday. De Claro will replace Henry Aguda, whose resignation was confirmed by Marcos over the weekend. READ: 3 candidates considered for DICT chief post […]...
